description: Deal Radar policy — a READ-ONLY discovery layer over decisions the radar has already made. Section sizes and admission floors live here, never in code. The feed re-scores nothing: package verdicts, stay scores, fare deal scores, trip scores, comparability, confidence, maturity refusals and bounded verdict language all come from their owning modules verbatim.

packages.note: One card per trip that has current-batch market verdicts; the lead verdict's reasons (incl. bounded statements) pass through VERBATIM. Best EXACT and best CLOSE are shown separately — a cheaper CLOSE never hides an EXACT. All-inclusive package DISCOVERY requires a real holiday length: all_inclusive cards below allInclusiveMinNights are excluded from THIS section only (a feed projection — the observations stay untouched and remain visible in the trips/market tooling); other boards and other sections are unaffected.

fares.note: Cheapest-first from the latest finished run of EACH trip type. ROUND_TRIP and ONE_WAY are different products and never share a section, a baseline or a difference framed as a saving. Below typical-fare maturity a card says 'cheapest observed', never 'deal'.

stays.note: Top stay candidates by their EXISTING 8c-8e score; suspicious rows excluded. Meta quotes stay labelled as sightings, never as bookable rates.

diy.note: Top composed trips by their EXISTING 8f score; unknown costs are listed by name, never zeroed.
